summary: Logan County, WV former tower with 1926-27 telephone records and a January 1987 photo; register says removed; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Register says the tower has been removed; no removal date given. Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks it Tower Gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register lists the administrator as the State of West Virginia; the Forest Lookouts page lists the West Virginia Division of Forestry. The story reports both. The sources do not say whether the two names refer to the same body.

notes_for_editor: Brief record checked: coordinates, registration date, agency and gone status match the sources; no corrections. The sources give no build date, design, staffing, fires, or removal date. Only 1926-27 telephone notes (reprinted from the Charleston Gazette and Raleigh Register) and a January 1987 photo date the tower. The FFLOS page is the only source naming the removal. Spelling of Sharples differs between the 1926 item (Sharplea) and the 1927 item (Sharples). A 1991 roadside marker reading Blair Mtn. Fire Tower Site Of Miners Battle appeared only in a search snippet; its WV History On View record returned HTTP 403, so it is not cited. The e-WV photo is cited as a page; no image URL was available, so no photos entry was added. Battlefield NRHP status is included as context and is not a tower event.
